source_refs.text: protected void renderLabels(GuiGraphics g,int mx,int my){g.drawString(font,title,8,9,0xffead8ac,false);int l=imageWidth*30/100;for(var row:rows.entrySet()){var q=quests.get(row.getKey());int yy=row.getValue()+2;var lines=font.split(tr("quest."+q.getString("Id")),l-36);g.renderItem(new ItemStack(q.getString("Type").equals("trophy")?Military.TOKEN.get():q.getString("Type").equals("defend")?org.slavicmyths.registry.ModItems.RETAINER_SHIELD.get():net.minecraft.world.item.Items.IRON_SWORD),10,yy+3);for(int n=0;n<lines.size();n++)g.drawString(font,lines.get(n),29,yy+n*9,0xff3b281c,false);int bottom=yy+lines.size()*9;g.drawString(font,tr("status."+status(q)),12,bottom,0xff713b30,false);var detail=font.split(Component.literal(q.getInt("Progress")+"/"+q.getInt("Amount")+" • ").append(tr("difficulty."+q.getInt("Difficulty"))),l-24);for(int n=0;n<detail.size();n++)g.drawString(font,detail.get(n),12,bottom+9+n*9,0xff493c2b,false);}}
